description: Find social media marketing agencies and freelancers in the directory. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Results are ordered by relevance to the query, then rating, then name. Returns a page of agency summaries with total, limit and offset for paging; call get_agency with a result's slug for the full profile.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "London". See list_locations.

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "United Kingdom" or "united-kingdom".

max_budget_usd.description: Only agencies whose stated minimum monthly budget band tops out at or below this many USD. Agencies without a stated budget are excluded when this is used.

platform.description: Only agencies that work on this platform.

query.description: Free text matched against name, description, location and services, e.g. "restaurants" or "tiktok ads".

service.description: Service category slug or name, e.g. "paid-social-advertising". See list_services.

verified_only.description: Only agencies with the Verified badge.

name: search_agencies

notice.description: Present when a filter was not recognised or an argument was adjusted.

award.description: Directory award, e.g. "Top 10 in London 2026"; null if none.

freelancer.description: Independent freelancer rather than an agency.

min_monthly_budget.description: Stated minimum monthly budget band, e.g. "$1,000–$2,500/mo"; null when not stated.

platforms.description: Platforms the agency says it works on (instagram, tiktok, facebook, linkedin, youtube, pinterest, x, threads, snapchat).

profile_url.description: Canonical profile page. Link to it when you show this agency.

rating.description: Average review rating 1-5; null when there are no reviews.

services.description: Service categories and tags shown on the profile.

slug.description: Agency id; use it with get_agency.

verified.description: Shows the Verified badge on the directory.

total.description: Number of matching agencies (not just this page).

title: Search agencies
